name: Sign in, add a client and a 3-day booking
description: Verifies a signed-in user can save a client and a multi-day booking whose day rate is multiplied by the booking days, and that both survive a reload.
steps: Sign in
Open the Clients tab, tap the add-client button, enter Acme Events as the company name and save
Open the Jobs tab and tap the round + button
Enter FOH Awards Night as the event name, choose Acme Events as the client, set the start date to 2026-12-01 and the end date to 2026-12-03
Tap 'Add row', enter Day rate as the description and 3500 as the rate
Tap Save booking
Reload the page and open the Jobs tab
expected: A booking card named FOH Awards Night with client Acme Events shows R 12 075,00 (3 days at R 3 500,00 plus 15% VAT) after the reload.

name: Block a booking without an event name
description: Verifies the booking form will not save without an event name.
steps: Sign in
Open the Jobs tab and tap the round + button
Leave the event name empty
Tap Save booking
expected: The form stays open with the event name field flagged as required and no booking card appears in the Jobs list.

name: Quote, accept, invoice and record full payment
setup: Sign in and create a booking named Wedding PA with start date 2026-12-10 and one charge line 'PA hire' with quantity 1 and rate 5000
description: Verifies the quote-to-paid workflow on one booking and that the results persist.
steps: Open the Wedding PA booking
Tap Create quote
Tap Client accepted
Tap 'Generate & send', then close the email sheet
Open the Wedding PA booking again, tap Record payment and save the suggested amount
Reload the page and open the Wedding PA booking
expected: The booking shows status Completed, a quote card with an Accepted badge, an invoice card with a Paid badge, and a recorded payment of R 5 750,00.

name: Delete a booking after confirming
setup: Sign in and create a booking named Delete Me with start date 2026-12-15
description: Verifies a booking is only removed after the delete confirmation and stays removed.
steps: Open the Delete Me booking
Open the more-actions menu (three dots) and choose Delete booking
Tap Delete booking in the confirmation box
Reload the page and open the Jobs tab with the All jobs filter
expected: No booking named Delete Me is listed after the reload.

name: Create a calendar subscription link
description: Verifies a user can create a private calendar subscription link from Settings.
steps: Sign in
Open the Settings tab and tap Calendar & sync
Tap Create my calendar link
expected: A private calendar link ending in .ics is shown with 'Subscribe on this device' and 'Copy link' buttons.
